methodology: Articles sourced from Virginia-specific RSS feeds and Google News RSS, filtered for AI/technology/workforce relevance, then assessed by Claude against the scenario framework. Each article is tagged with the region it most affects and the scenario it signals toward.

signals.title: Norfolk native brings free AI workshops to Hampton Roads to close the technology gap - WTKR
signals.signal_reading: Free AI workshops in Hampton Roads represent grassroots capability-building outside metro hubs, signaling potential for distributed deep learning through community-driven education rather than platform dependency.

signals.title: Roanoke College launches WorkAI Lab to prepare leaders for new era of technology - Roanoke College
signals.signal_reading: Roanoke College's WorkAI Lab demonstrates institutional AI investment in a mid-tier region, but its focus on leadership training rather than broad workforce development suggests concentrated expertise within educated cohorts rather than distributed capability.

signals.title: New partnership between VCU and AI Ready RVA aims to boost AI education, innovation and community impact - VCU News
signals.signal_reading: VCU's partnership with AI Ready RVA explicitly targets community impact and education infrastructure, creating conditions for distributed capability development beyond just tech sector concentration in Richmond.

signals.title: Digital Realty to buy Alexandria VC firm founded by Warner
signals.signal_reading: A $775 million VC acquisition in Alexandria reinforces NoVA's position as Virginia's AI capital formation center, concentrating investment decision-making power and deal flow in the metro corridor rather than distributing it statewide.

signals.title: ‘Shaping our future’: Company powering AI data centers invests $50+ million in Henrico, adding 200 jobs - WWBT
signals.signal_reading: A $50M+ AI infrastructure investment adding 200 jobs in Henrico signals Richmond's emergence as a secondary concentration node, but datacenter jobs may represent shallow operational roles rather than deep AI capability development.
